problem_title: Add Lightning Web Component to Lightning Tab
problem: I am trying to figure out how to add a Lightning Web Component to a Lightning tab. I have it on the Home Page, but I would like it to be on its own tab. I feel like there should be an option to expose it to the Lightning tabs. When I am in the Tabs section, I don't see my LWC listed.
explanation: From Winter 20 release you are able to set it as Tab. All you need to do is: Open -meta.xml file from your LWC component Change is exposed to True: <isExposed>true</isExposed> Add <target>lightning__Tab</target> Open Tab from setup and under Lightning Component Tabs press New and select your LWC component.
